name: Kansas City Chiefs
summary: A founding AFL rivalry that began when Kansas City was still the Dallas Texans. The series has repeatedly carried division, playoff and championship consequences.

name: Denver Broncos
summary: Oakland and Denver entered the AFL together in 1960 and have remained division rivals ever since, including two postseason meetings and a long history of prime-time games.

name: Los Angeles Chargers
summary: The Raiders and Chargers have shared a division since the AFL's first season, through the Chargers' Los Angeles and San Diego identities and the Raiders' Oakland, Los Angeles and Las Vegas eras.

name: Pittsburgh Steelers
summary: The Raiders-Steelers rivalry became one of the defining AFC conflicts of the 1970s, with six postseason meetings that included five playoff clashes in that decade alone.

name: San Francisco 49ers
kind: Historic geographic rivalry · Battle of the Bay
summary: The Battle of the Bay grew from geography, fan identity and decades of shared Northern California football culture. The teams have met only 15 times in the regular season, but the matchup became one of the Raiders' most emotionally charged non-division rivalries.
